title: settings
description: One row per account, row id "current". A field nobody has written yet reads as its default. "Ring here" is per device and does not sync.

auto_break.description: Start the break when a lap rings.

auto_work.description: Start the next lap when a break rings.

sound.description: Id of the bell. The set is pinned in roadmap section 8.

day_target.description: Pomodoros a day. 0 is no target.

share_task.description: Rooms may see the title of the task in progress.

rest_days.description: Weekdays pinned as rest for the focus streak, bit 0 Monday to bit 6 Sunday, at most two. protocol.md section 8.

marks.description: Marks already shown, by key, with the time. protocol.md section 16.
